text_block_list.text:
The day of the Elm Stakes. Haru Urara 
longs to run with everything she's got.

Just before the race, the shopping street 
folks who came all this way to cheer 
earnestly tell her, "We want you to win."

Receiving the heartfelt wishes of the 
shopping district's people, Haru Urara, 
feeling a sensation different from simple 
excitement—

Not just to have fun, but to "win"—she 
dashed out onto the racetrack.
